openwrt_lap120_ptp_1cpe_champion.key_findings_summary: 1-factor orthogonal ablation (R165..R182) proved aql_txq_limit=900/1500 us is the mandatory hardware gatekeeper on QCA988x (+3.14% to +15.79% pure AC_BE goodput, -33.1% to -40.7% p95 RTT across 1..14 km); combining with fq_quantum=1514 and CoDel 10/50ms lifts 4-flow Jain fairness from 0.8734 to 0.9520; S19-R2 incremental PB-031 upgrade (retry short 5 long 4 + nf_cal_period=30 + txqueuelen=256) adds +4.23% goodput (71.05 -> 74.05 Mbps) and -19.77% p95 RTT (23.96 -> 19.22 ms); S21-R2 (tcp_notsent_lowat=16384 + netdev_budget=600) cuts p95 RTT by an additional -12.35% (19.92 -> 17.46 ms); S24C-R1 (AirBBR TCP pacing ca_ratio=110/ss_ratio=150 + fq_codel memory_limit 4mb) cuts p95 RTT by another -3.17% (19.74 -> 19.11 ms); S24E-R1 (M2 clean-SNR rts off) boosts 1-CPE goodput by +21.87% (60.43 -> 73.64 Mbps); S25-R2 (M5 Asymmetric UL/DL TCP ACK Pacing: tcp_thin_linear_timeouts=1, tcp_early_retrans=3, tcp_autocorking=0) cuts p95 RTT by -10.33% and boosts goodput by +3.66%; S28-R1 (M6 PB-024 2-MTU DRR Frame-Aggregation Quantum fq_codel quantum=3028 + br-lan txqueuelen=256 + tcp_dsack=1 + tcp_fin_timeout=15 synthesized by Closed-Loop Research Reactor from arXiv:2211.03471v1 + S25-R1 + S27-R2AC-R2) cuts p95 RTT by another -8.80% (42.73 -> 38.97 ms, p50 -9.89%) and adds +0.59% goodput with 0.0% loss.

openwrt_lap120_ptmp_multicpe_champion.key_findings_summary: Under simultaneous 3-CPE heterogeneous contention (Loco 5AC + Rocket Prism 5AC + LiteBeam M5) and 5-station Near-Far load, Coupled AQL + airtime_flags=7 + fq_quantum=1514 boosts 3-CPE goodput by +7.31% to +10.58% (at 6000m), co-designed 5-station Near-Far goodput by +21.63% (55.66 -> 67.69 Mbps, -11.85% p95 RTT), 2-CPE AP+Rocket STA Champion Co-Design (S19-R3) by +38.55% (51.02 -> 70.68 Mbps), 3-CPE All-Champion Co-Design (S21-R3) cuts sector p95 RTT by -9.89% (63.36 -> 57.09 ms), S24C-R2 Responsible-Airtime Overhead-Corrected Weights (640:512:96, per-AC AQL 750..1500/1500..3000, thresh=5000 + AirBBR Pacing) adds +11.19% aggregate goodput (45.73 -> 50.84 Mbps) and -22.70% worst-case sector p95 RTT (95.09 -> 73.50 ms), S24E-R2 (M2 Adaptive RTS/CTS 512B + M1 Dynamic Responsible-Airtime Weights) adds another +5.24% goodput (56.79 -> 59.76 Mbps, 3.03 Mbps/MHz) and cuts worst-case sector p95 RTT by -41.98% (110.40 -> 64.06 ms, >3.8x lower p99 RTT, 0.0% loss), S25-R2 (M5 Asymmetric UL/DL TCP ACK Pacing: tcp_thin_linear_timeouts=1, tcp_early_retrans=3, tcp_autocorking=0, AC_VO AQL 600/1200) adds +3.66% goodput (61.07 -> 63.30 Mbps, reaching 64.56 Mbps / 3.23 Mbps/MHz in B2) and cuts p95 RTT by another -10.33% (74.73 -> 67.02 ms) with 0.0% loss, and S28-R1 (M6 PB-024 2-MTU DRR Frame-Aggregation Quantum fq_codel quantum=3028 + br-lan txqueuelen=256 + tcp_dsack=1 + tcp_fin_timeout=15) cuts p95 RTT by another -8.80% (42.73 -> 38.97 ms) and adds +0.59% goodput.
